rounds.kill_strategy: Unkillable - the mutation is in a documentation string (docstring), not in any executable code. rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing tools should exclude docstrings and comments from mutation candidates, as they are semantically inert and always produce equivalent mutants. Consider adding a pre-filter that identifies string literals used as docstrings (first expression in class/function body) and skips them during mutation generation.
